# Vexaloom Labs documentation

Published Actor references and Python usage recipes.

- [2GIS Business Directory Extractor for CIS & Middle East](https://asimkhaniqbal.github.io/apify-actor-examples/actors/egAceUslWJ9ezEaPL/): Search 2GIS for businesses by category and city across Russia, the UAE, Kazakhstan and the wider CIS, and get name, address, rating, hours, contacts and social links for each place.
- [Ahrefs Domain Rating, Backlinks & Traffic Lookup](https://asimkhaniqbal.github.io/apify-actor-examples/actors/gUzxxjRtJtq8KiIiG/): Look up a domain's public Ahrefs Domain Rating, linking-website count, global rank, and estimated organic traffic, with a mode to fetch just authority or just backlink metrics.
- [AliExpress Multi-Region Search, Store & Review Scraper](https://asimkhaniqbal.github.io/apify-actor-examples/actors/fViwyNdEyDapUpGXy/): Search AliExpress or fetch product, store, and review records by ID or URL across 18 regional storefronts and 42 currencies, with price, rating, and ship-from/ship-to filters.
- [Allegro.pl Listings by Search, Category or URL](https://asimkhaniqbal.github.io/apify-actor-examples/actors/yTGdPYNIY8yiaWGK5/): Find Allegro.pl products by keyword search, category page, or direct offer URL, with price, seller rating, condition, shipping, and rating details, filterable by price range and free shipping.
- [Amazon Autocomplete Keyword Expander](https://asimkhaniqbal.github.io/apify-actor-examples/actors/zgFNSzKiYNCzNrdL9/): Turn seed keywords into Amazon's own search-box autocomplete suggestions across 23 marketplaces. Expand past the usual per-query cap with A-Z/0-9/custom suffixes and recursive re-querying of newly found suggestions.
- [Amazon Customer Review & Rating Summary Scraper](https://asimkhaniqbal.github.io/apify-actor-examples/actors/1u5Fn40qo93nWNJ8t/): Get Amazon customer reviews and a product-level rating summary by product URL, keyword, or category, with star-rating and sort filters, across 23 Amazon domains.
- [AutoScout24 Vehicle Listings with Dealer Contact Details](https://asimkhaniqbal.github.io/apify-actor-examples/actors/yffB7HBFSXcZB6sjC/): Search AutoScout24 across eight European countries by make, price, mileage and location, and get full vehicle specs, equipment, photos and dealer contact details.
- [Craigslist Classifieds Scraper with Category Attributes](https://asimkhaniqbal.github.io/apify-actor-examples/actors/PfjY6S7qeKQpmGEqc/): Scrape Craigslist search results and individual posts across any city subdomain, with category-specific attributes for jobs, housing, autos, and for-sale posts. No login or proxy required.
- [Crunchbase News & Funding Coverage Scraper](https://asimkhaniqbal.github.io/apify-actor-examples/actors/ENvuFWjzo2bkbq29t/): Extract Crunchbase's editorial news articles on startup funding, M&A, IPOs and tech trends: full text, author, publish date, categories, tags and featured image. Filter by keyword, category or date.
- [Domain-Scoped Site Crawler for Markdown Datasets](https://asimkhaniqbal.github.io/apify-actor-examples/actors/daEeIAgzVqlS9oXl8/): Crawl a website from one or more start URLs, staying on the same domain, and get back clean Markdown, text, or HTML per page with title, description, and crawl depth. Built for feeding LLM, RAG, or knowledge-base pipelines.
- [eBay Item, Store & Store Category Detail Extractor](https://asimkhaniqbal.github.io/apify-actor-examples/actors/ue8AF0IdZnL8KILaW/): Extract detailed product data from eBay individual item pages, seller store fronts, and store category pages, or search by keyword across 8 marketplaces, with item specifics, images, seller trust signals and shipping/return terms.
- [eBay Multi-Marketplace Listing & Seller Data Scraper](https://asimkhaniqbal.github.io/apify-actor-examples/actors/viDUFMwWczdagyjtn/): Search eBay listings by keyword or category across 8 marketplaces, with titles, prices, conditions, sellers, ratings, watch counts, sold counts and shipping costs.
- [Ecwid App Market Pricing & Category Scraper](https://asimkhaniqbal.github.io/apify-actor-examples/actors/1HhF1jdDY6OOB3f9b/): Scrape apps from the Ecwid (Lightspeed E-Series) App Market - name, developer, description, categories, pricing type, and icon. Browse the whole market, filter by category, or search by keyword.
- [ESPN Scores, Standings, Teams & News by League](https://asimkhaniqbal.github.io/apify-actor-examples/actors/9euiAfrRYDea19ZZ9/): Pull live and recent scores, league standings, team rosters, news headlines, and full game boxscores for NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, MLS, Premier League, La Liga, F1, UFC, PGA Golf, ATP Tennis, and more.
- [Facebook Event Details & New-Event Monitor Scraper](https://asimkhaniqbal.github.io/apify-actor-examples/actors/xSp7vACk0FpUckkaH/): Fetch public Facebook event details by URL, page listing, or keyword/city search, with venue GPS, hosts, ticket links, and a monitor mode that reports only newly-posted events.
- [Facebook Group Feed & Engagement Extractor](https://asimkhaniqbal.github.io/apify-actor-examples/actors/aFlHZPCMOjot2Ym8e/): Pull posts from any public Facebook group with full text, media, reaction breakdown, top comments and reshares, plus optional group member count, admins and rules.
- [Facebook Page & Profile Finder by Keyword or URL](https://asimkhaniqbal.github.io/apify-actor-examples/actors/CJq13RwjCKKPE9rcc/): Find Facebook Pages or public profiles by keyword, or scrape a list of Facebook URLs directly, and get back contact info, category, ratings, follower counts, reviews, and recent posts.
- [Facebook Page Photo Gallery & Engagement Scraper](https://asimkhaniqbal.github.io/apify-actor-examples/actors/2EIffCKePvtaP7w1K/): Collect photos from public Facebook pages, profiles, and albums with full-resolution image URLs, alt text, captions, reaction breakdowns, share and comment counts, and tagged people.
- [Facebook Political & Commercial Ad Transparency Extractor](https://asimkhaniqbal.github.io/apify-actor-examples/actors/6Dh4fWQXIee4jhMOE/): Search the Facebook Ad Library by keyword, advertiser Page ID, Ad ID, or funding-entity name, and get ad text, media, run dates, platforms, and spend or impressions for political and issue ads.
- [Facebook Post & Group Comment Thread Extractor](https://asimkhaniqbal.github.io/apify-actor-examples/actors/gCko1ssooveQ4r5cK/): Get comments and nested reply threads from public Facebook posts, Watch videos, photos, and group posts, with per-reaction-type counts, author details, and date filtering. No login or cookies required.
- [Fiverr Gig & Seller Sitemap Directory Scraper](https://asimkhaniqbal.github.io/apify-actor-examples/actors/yra4HTNkAQ1pjZ1g7/): List live Fiverr gigs, seller profiles, categories, search tags and Logo Maker ideas straight from Fiverr's own directories, with best-effort full gig detail by URL.
- [Fotocasa Spain Sale & Rental Listings Scraper](https://asimkhaniqbal.github.io/apify-actor-examples/actors/o33Jzuf8dGQeft46K/): Search Fotocasa listings for sale or rent across Spain by city, property type, price range, and bedrooms. Each result includes price, size, bedrooms, bathrooms, location, images, and the listing URL.
